description: Step 4: register a committed transaction by txHash. Kinds: create-caper, buy, sell, swap, proposal, vote, count, trigger, resolve, execute, activate-upgrade, exit, withdraw-founder, transfer-founder. The server verifies before mirroring anything: receipts are re-read on-ledger (forged or foreign txHashes are refused, replays are idempotent). Context per kind – create-caper, exit, withdraw-founder, transfer-founder: cashtag; proposal: proposalId; count, trigger, resolve, execute, activate-upgrade: code (the P-… code). Requires the Bearer token from the `login` tool, sent as an HTTP `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header on the POST carrying this call.

cashtag.description: create-caper, exit and the founder kinds: the caper's cashtag

code.description: the cranks after the vote: the proposal's P-… code

proposalId.description: proposal: the id from the create-proposal manifest response

name: submit_tx
title: Register a committed transaction
